story.asA: user who has forgotten my password
story.iWant: to request a password reset link to be sent to my email address
story.soThat: I can regain access to my account by setting a new password.
story.tasks: - Task 1: Add a "Forgot Password?" link to the login page UI. (AC: 1) - Task 2: Create a new page/route at `/auth/forgot-password` with a form for email input. (AC: 2) - Task 3: Implement the `sendPasswordReset` method in `AuthManager` to call `supabase.auth.resetPasswordForEmail()`. (AC: 3) - Task 4: Connect the form to the `AuthManager.sendPasswordReset` method and implement a loading state on the submit button. - Task 5: Display a success toast notification upon a successful API response, using the generic text recommended in the story notes for security. (AC: 7) - Task 6: Create a new page/route at `/auth/update-password` to handle the password update flow triggered by the email link. (AC: 5, 6) - Task 7: Implement the UI for the new password form on the update page. (AC: 6) - Task 8: Write a unit test for the `AuthManager.sendPasswordReset` method. - Task 9: Write an E2E test for the full password reset flow. (AC: All)

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: - AC 1: Given I am on the login page, Then a "Forgot Password?" link must be clearly visible. - AC 2: Given I click the "Forgot Password?" link, When the UI updates, Then I must be presented with a form asking for my registered email address. - AC 3: Given I enter my registered email address and submit the form, When the action is triggered, Then the client-side `AuthManager.sendPasswordReset(email)` function must be invoked. - AC 4: Given the `sendPasswordReset` call to Supabase is successful, When I check my email inbox, Then I must find an email from the application containing a unique, single-use password reset link. - AC 5: Given I click the password reset link in the email, Then I must be redirected to a secure page within the application dedicated to setting a new password. - AC 6: Given I am on the password reset page, When I enter and confirm a new password that meets the application's security requirements, Then my account credentials in Supabase must be securely updated with the new password. - AC 7: Given my password has been successfully reset, Then I must be redirected to the login page with a success notification (e.g., a toast) stating, "Your password has been updated. Please log in."

doc.title: Epic Technical Specification: User Authentication & Onboarding
doc.snippet: Password Reset: User enters their email in the "Forgot Password" form. `AuthManager` calls `supabase.auth.resetPasswordForEmail(email)`. Supabase sends a password reset link to the user's email. The user clicks the link, is taken to a reset page, and provides a new password.

doc.title: Epic Technical Specification: User Authentication & Onboarding
doc.snippet: Password reset links will be single-use and expire after a short period (Supabase default is 24 hours).

doc.title: AI-Powered Personal Study Planner - Solution Architecture
doc.snippet: Supabase Auth (GoTrue) is the authentication service responsible for managing user sign-up, login, password resets, and issuing JWTs.

doc.title: UX Design Specification
doc.snippet: Success Feedback: Non-intrusive "toast" notifications will be used (e.g., in the bottom-right corner). They will appear for 3-4 seconds and then fade automatically to confirm a successful action.

story-context.constraints: - All authentication logic must be handled through the `AuthManager` client-side service. - The implementation must use the `supabase.auth.resetPasswordForEmail()` method. - UI components must be from the Shadcn UI library. - New routes `/auth/forgot-password` and `/auth/update-password` must be created. - For security, display a generic success message even if the email does not exist in the system to prevent user enumeration.

interface.name: IAuthManager

tests.standards: Use a testing framework like Cypress or Playwright for E2E tests. Create unit tests for services like AuthManager, mocking external calls. Test UI components in isolation.
tests.locations: - Unit/Service Tests: `src/services/__tests__/` - Component Tests: `src/components/__tests__/` - E2E Tests: `cypress/e2e/`
tests.ideas: - (AC 3) Unit test the `AuthManager.sendPasswordReset` method to ensure it calls the Supabase client with the correct email. - (AC 2) Integration test of the forgot password form to ensure it's displayed correctly. - (AC 4) E2E test: Request a password reset and check for a (mocked) email. - (AC 5, 6, 7) E2E test: Complete the full flow from clicking the reset link, entering a new password, and being redirected to the login page with a success toast.
